factor_hypotheses.momentum: Recent trend may persist over short horizons; test sign and stability.
factor_hypotheses.volatility: High realized volatility may proxy for risk and unstable returns.
factor_hypotheses.volume_and_amount: Relative activity may represent attention, liquidity, or reversal.
factor_hypotheses.range_and_gap: Intraday range and opening gap may capture price pressure.
factor_hypotheses.amihud: Higher absolute price impact per traded amount may indicate illiquidity.
factor_hypotheses.rsi: Recent gain/loss imbalance may capture short-horizon momentum or reversal.
factor_hypotheses.status: Exploratory hypotheses only; predictive value has not been evaluated.

factor_definitions.ret_1: One previous valid stock observation close-to-close return.
factor_definitions.mom_5/mom_20/mom_60: Close-to-close return over 5/20/60 previous valid stock observations.
factor_definitions.volatility_5/20/60: Population standard deviation of the latest 5/20/60 close returns.
factor_definitions.sma_ratio_5_20/sma_ratio_20_60: Ratio of trailing close moving averages minus one.
factor_definitions.volume_ratio_5_20: Trailing 5-observation mean volume divided by 20-observation mean, minus one.
factor_definitions.amount_ratio_5_20: Trailing 5-observation mean amount divided by 20-observation mean, minus one.
factor_definitions.turnover_mean_20: Mean turnover across the latest 20 valid observations.
factor_definitions.intraday_range_pct: (High - low) / close for the current observation.
factor_definitions.close_location: (2 * close - high - low) / (high - low), with zero for zero-range bars.
factor_definitions.open_gap_pct: Open / preclose - one for the current observation.
factor_definitions.amihud_20: Mean absolute close return / amount over 20 observations, scaled by 1e8.
factor_definitions.rsi_14: Simple-average RSI over the latest 14 close-return observations.
factor_definitions.fwd_return_5d/fwd_return_20d: Same-security close-to-close return to exactly 5/20 later training market dates; rows without an in-training endpoint are excluded.

label_definition.horizons: 5 and 20 subsequent dates in the training split trading calendar.
label_definition.entry_execution: Research label only; it is not an executable return model. Backtests must model signal availability and next-session fills.

data_limitations: The raw source uses adjustflag=3 (unadjusted); corporate actions can distort both factors and labels.
Factor windows count valid per-security observations and can span suspension or missing-data gaps.
Training inputs have already filtered securities by the project listing-age rule.
No cross-sectional scaling or imputation is applied; fit any learned transform on training data only.
